metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: ICOCIO crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group C c. Reported CIF formula moiety: C40 H36 Mn3 N8 O6 4+,H2 Ce1 N5 O16 2-,2(N1 O3 1-),2(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Ce1 (Ce) has 11 O neighbors; Mn1 (Mn) has 4 O neighbors; Mn2 (Mn) has 4 O neighbors; Mn3 (Mn) has 2 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 3 pairs, 2 components; largest component is a network with cycles with approximately planar metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 2.670-3.259 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 95.13-130.74°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C40H42CeMn3N15O30. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 2 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)), 5 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)), 1 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
